PLAN "3-Week Reconditioning Block: Post-Illness Return"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Restore pre-illness strength and work capacity"

PHASES
  PHASE "Reconditioning" (3 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x6 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body C":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2m
          back_stretch 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x40s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          overhead_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body C":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2m
          back_stretch 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          plank 3x50s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x4 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          overhead_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bird_dog 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Full Body C":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          seated_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x40s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2m
          back_stretch 2m

goals.name: Restore pre-illness strength and work capacity
